reason: At 500 updates, empirical aligned-teacher training improves teacher CA-lDDT and state-frequency agreement but reduces recall. Only 21 of 51 singleton teacher states are hit; all majority states are hit. Neither teacher arm passes the original capacity criterion.
scope: Same frozen reliable32 training proteins and contact-state definitions. No development or locked-test selection.
distribution: Equal mass per teacher-defined contact state, then uniform over valid teacher conformations within that state. No reference mixture. This intentionally changes the empirical teacher prior and does not estimate biological populations.
initialization: Same original 459M EMA checkpoint as controls; no warm start from a selected checkpoint.
unchanged: Learning rate, optimizer, target order, batch sizes32/16/8/8, precision, EMA, Gaussian/time/dropout streams, evaluator and seeds. Exactly one label uniform draw per example; frame arms map that draw to the same teacher index.
evaluation: Retain CFG1 primary and CFG2 sensitivity, both contact thresholds, all samples and geometry failures. Original empirical-teacher state TV remains reported; also report TV against the balanced target prior and singleton-state hits.
success: Apply the original capacity criterion versus initialization and reference. Separately compare balanced versus empirical within each frame with paired family intervals. No promotion from training-set results. A decline in teacher-frequency agreement must remain visible.
next: Broader/generalization testing only after credible capacity evidence; otherwise examine final curves and target-time behavior. Posterior-target full training is deferred because its measured conditional variance accounts for only a few percent of the objective.
